message.content:
To log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, follow these steps:

## How to Log In

1. **Visit the official MSCA page:** Go to [www.canada.ca/msca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html)

2. **Click "Register or Sign in to MSCA"**

3. **Choose your sign-in method:**
   - **GCKey** – A Government of Canada username and password
   - **Sign-In Partner (Interac®)** – Use your online banking credentials from participating banks (RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, Desjardins, etc.)
   - **Provincial Digital ID** – Available only for Alberta and British Columbia residents

4. **Enter your credentials** and complete any multi-factor authentication if required

---

## What You Can Access in MSCA

Once logged in, you can manage:
- Employment Insurance (EI)
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP)
- Old Age Security (OAS)
- Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) information
- Canada Apprentice Loan
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A)
- Direct deposit and personal information updates

---

## Important Notes

- **Multi-factor authentication is now required** when signing in with GCKey or your bank (Sign-In Partner) for enhanced security
- **New users** must register first and may need a **Personal Access Code (PAC)** sent by mail (takes 5–10 business days)
- **Student loan borrowers:** As of May 25, 2025, the National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) is now accessed through MSCA

If you're having trouble logging in, you can contact Service Canada for assistance or visit the GCKey help page for credential issues.

---

Sources:
1. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html
2. https://srv136.services.gc.ca/ECAS-SECA/RASCL/Support/HelpPage.aspx?rurl=/ecas-seca/rascl/SCL/Authentication.aspx
3. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/cpp-oas.html
4. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account/cal.html
5. https://www.insurdinary.ca/my-service-canada-account-guide/
